verdicts.reason: Both leave the building photo starting about 100px in from the left, so there's a dead white strip on the left edge and the image no longer bleeds off the canvas as it does in the original. A at least keeps the headline right-aligned with a sensible right margin, close to the original. B has the same dead left strip, plus its headline sits on a white box that stops at about x=625, leaving a visible seam and an off-white band on the right. Its text also floats away from the right edge, so the layout looks unanchored.
